title: Tikka Masala Banana Pancakes
description: A sweet twist on traditional Indian street food, these fluffy pancakes are infused with the flavors of tikka masala and topped with caramelized bananas.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together milk, egg, and melted butter.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Drop the batter by 1/4 cupfuls onto the skillet or griddle.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, until bubbles appear on the surface and the edges start to dry.
Flip the pancakes and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
While the pancakes are cooking, caramelize the bananas by cooking them in a skillet over medium heat for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Serve the pancakes hot with caramelized bananas on top and a sprinkle of tikka masala spice mix.
